name: cold14-e1
title: PR604's cold-ended construction with ColdSupply's cold-end recipes, at a free dispatch (jp8 x68, atm3 x4) chosen by the aggregate hosting LP, with an exact per-time-Hall owner map from an exact-window MIP (RINS)
summary: Provider menu {ck, atm3, jp8}: PR604's chains (DreamingOfClouds), ending with `cold_end` using ColdSupply's recipes (E1-pair words; code/cold_end_controls.py adds entering low-frame-end mutants). ColdOwner's recipe.py pipeline, all with the window-MILP nominator solve_h.py (PR569 nominate_width7.py adapted; objective sum F(r) = r*(73/r)^b, b = 0.00162): (1) aggregate free-dispatch LP over the menu (crossover, tight 3: every pattern with idle remainder <= 3), warm-started from the R1 map for pattern seeding -> LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json; (2) dispatch = per-time argmax of the LP selections -> DISPATCH.json (jp8 x68, atm3 x4; ck never selected); (3) exact-window LP (crossover) at that dispatch over base + AGG patterns with weight >= 0.01 -> LP-PATTERNS-EX.json, objective 523250.349; (4) exact-window MIP at that dispatch, RINS around the EX vertex (slack 2/1), gap 1e-9, HiGHS mip_detect_symmetry=false -> optimal; (5) mkplan.py: PLAN = solve output with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted locals and profile/assignment_sha256 recomputed from the map (reproduces data/PLAN.json byte for byte). The map is admitted by the package's verifier chain, not by the search.

dispatch.origin: at the free dispatch jp8 ×68, atm3 ×4 (per-time argmax of the aggregate free-dispatch hosting LP over {ck, atm3, jp8}; ck is never selected)
dispatch.plan_rule: the window MIP's PLAN with the provider registry re-derived from the admitted provider locals and `profile`/`assignment_sha256` recomputed from the map (ColdOwner mkplan.py)

owners.origin: an exact per-time-Hall exact-window MIP solution at gap 1e-9 (RINS around the exact-window LP vertex)
owners.warm_owners_origin: the R1 map (`data/OWNERS.json.gz` of research/complex-571-cold14-r1, byte for byte), used only to seed the aggregate LP's patterns

search.dispatch_rule: per time t: argmax over providers of LP-PATTERNS-AGG selections[t]

lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-AGG.json: aggregate free-dispatch LP relaxation over {ck, atm3, jp8} (crossover, tight 3), pattern-seeded from the R1 map
lp_inputs.DISPATCH.json: the dispatch {time: provider} = per-time argmax of the aggregate LP selections
lp_inputs.LP-PATTERNS-EX.json: exact-window LP relaxation (crossover) at that dispatch over the base patterns plus aggregate-LP patterns with weight >= 0.01
lp_inputs.WARM-PLAN.json: the R1 PLAN matching WARM-OWNERS.json.gz (pattern seeding of the aggregate LP)
lp_inputs.TEMPLATE-PLAN.json: PR604's data/PLAN.json, whose windows/order/registry template the nominator reuses
